analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price (90,285 KRW) vs SMA5 (94,849 KRW)/SMA20 (109,542 KRW)/SMA50 (160,309 KRW) — below short/mid-term trends, indicating a weak zone.

· 52-week position (29.2%) — approaching historical low levels, a zone for potential rebound exploration.

· MACD histogram trajectory (-2334.8846→841.4101) — improvement within negative territory, weak signal for bearish reversal.

· Swing resistance (95,500 KRW) — potential for short-term rebound attempt if broken.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Lower High confirmed, 5-day low 86,650 KRW) — confirming continued downtrend.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.49x) — subdued volume, decreasing confidence in price movement.
· Current zone diagnosis (Downtrend) — initiating short position, condition for switching to wait-and-see if 95,500 KRW is breached.
